description: Madhya Pradesh Western Region Power Distribution Company has installed 1.24 lakh smart meters in Indore city that drive huge data every hour about loading, readings and several other parameters.
body_lead: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT)-Indore will assist the electricity department in using advanced tools based on artificial intelligence and machine learning for theft detection, smooth supply of electricity and efficient use of smart meter data.Madhya Pradesh Western Region Power Distribution Company has installed 1.24 lakh smart meters in Indore city that drive huge data every hour about loading, readings and several other parameters.discom managing director Amit Tomar said,IIT Indore’s electrical engineering professor Dr Trapti Jain said.
